#数据整理

```{r}
#数据下载 光动力治疗前后
rm(list = ls())
gse_number = "GSE84756"
eSet <- getGEO(gse_number, 
               destdir = '.', 
               getGPL = F)
eSet = eSet[[1]]
#(1)提取表达矩阵exp
exp <- exprs(eSet)
exp[1:4,1:4]
boxplot(exp)
#(2)提取临床信息、删除DT,LC50组
pd <- pData(eSet)
pd <- pd[!grepl("DT|LC90", pd$`treatment:ch1`) & grepl("HUVEC", pd$`cell line:ch1`), ]
#(3)调整pd的行名顺序与exp列名完全一致
p = identical(rownames(pd),colnames(exp));p
if(!p) exp = exp[,match(rownames(pd),colnames(exp))]
#(4)提取芯片平台编号
gpl_number <- eSet@annotation
save(gse_number,pd,exp,gpl_number,file = "stepout/step1output.Rdata")
```
#2
```{r}
# Group(实验分组)和ids(探针注释)
rm(list = ls())  
load(file = "stepout/step1output.Rdata")
# 1.Group----
# 匹配关键词，自行分类
Group=ifelse(str_detect(pd$"treatment:ch1","Control"),"Control","PDT")
#设置参考水平，指定levels，对照组在前，处理组在后
Group = factor(Group,levels = c("Control","PDT"))
#探针注释
# illumina包注释
ls('package:illuminaHumanv4.db')
ids <- toTable(illuminaHumanv4SYMBOL)
save(exp,Group,ids,gse_number,file = "stepout/step2output.Rdata")
```
#3
```{r}
rm(list = ls()) 
load(file = 'stepout/step1output.Rdata')
load(file = 'stepout/step2output.Rdata')
# 每次都要检测数据
dat <- exp
dat[1:4,1:4]
table(Group)
g=Group
g=relevel(g,'Control')
design=model.matrix(~g)
#影响表达量的批次
batch=pd$`treatment:ch1`
batch=factor(batch)
batch
## 使用 limma 的 removeBatchEffect 函数
dat[1:4,1:4]
ex_b_limma <- removeBatchEffect(dat,
                                batch = batch,
                                design = design)
#ex_b_limma 去除批次效应后的矩阵                               
dim(ex_b_limma)
ex_b_limma[1:4,1:4]

#PCA图
dat=as.data.frame(t(ex_b_limma))

dat.pca <- PCA(dat, graph = FALSE)
pca_plot <- fviz_pca_ind(dat.pca,
                         geom.ind = "point", # show points only (nbut not "text")
                         col.ind = Group, # color by groups
                         palette = c("#9eaad1", "#f59790"),
                         addEllipses = TRUE, # Concentration ellipses
                         legend.title = "Groups"
)
pca_plot
ggsave(plot = pca_plot,filename = paste0(gse_number,"_PCA.png"),path="stepout/")
```

#4差异分析、获取ENTREZID
```{r}
rm(list = ls()) 
load(file = "stepout/step2output.Rdata")
#差异分析，用limma包来做
#需要表达矩阵和Group，不需要改
design=model.matrix(~Group)
fit=lmFit(exp,design)
fit=eBayes(fit)
deg=topTable(fit,coef=2,number = Inf)

#为deg数据框添加几列
#1.加probe_id列，把行名变成一列
deg <- mutate(deg,probe_id=rownames(deg))
head(deg)
#2.加上探针注释
ids = ids[!duplicated(ids$symbol),]
deg <- inner_join(deg,ids,by="probe_id")
head(deg)
nrow(deg)

#3.加change列,标记上下调基因
logFC_t=1
P.Value_t = 0.05
k1 = (deg$adj.P.Val < P.Value_t)&(deg$logFC < -logFC_t)
k2 = (deg$adj.P.Val < P.Value_t)&(deg$logFC > logFC_t)
deg <- mutate(deg,change = ifelse(k1,"down",ifelse(k2,"up","stable")))
table(deg$change)

#4.加ENTREZID列，用于富集分析（symbol转entrezid，然后inner_join）
s2e <- toTable(illuminaHumanv4ENTREZID)
dim(deg)
deg <- inner_join(deg,s2e,by=c("probe_id"="probe_id"))
dim(deg)
length(unique(deg$symbol))
save(Group,deg,logFC_t,P.Value_t,gse_number,file = "stepout/step4output.Rdata")
```

#5. 差异基因分析

```{r}
#差异基因火山图
p <- ggplot(data = deg,
            aes(x = logFC,
                y = -log10(P.Value))) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 1.5,
             aes(color = change)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#9eaad1", "#CCCCCC", "#f59790")) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-logFC_t, logFC_t),
             linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50", size = 0.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(P.Value_t),
             linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50", size = 0.5) +
  geom_text_repel(
    data          = subset(deg, symbol == "DUSP1"),
    aes(label     = symbol),
    color         = "black",
    size          = 5,
    fontface      = "italic",
    box.padding   = 0.8,
    point.padding = 0.5,
    segment.color = "black",
    arrow         = arrow(length = unit(0.015, "npc"))
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    title = "Volcano Plot",
    x     = "Log2 Fold Change",
    y     = "-Log10(P-value)"
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title     = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 16),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title   = element_blank()
  )

print(p)             # 连接线的粗细

```

# 富集

```{r}
# =============================================================================
# Figure 2I: PDT 响应基因 GO/KEGG 富集气泡图
# =============================================================================

rm(list = ls())
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)

# ── 1. 载入数据 ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
load("stepout/step4output.Rdata")   # deg, logFC_t, P.Value_t, Group

# ── 2. 提取显著差异基因的 Entrez ID ───────────────────────────────────────────
# deg 中已有 entrezid 列（step4 通过 illuminaHumanv4ENTREZID 注释）
sig_entrez <- deg %>%
  filter(change %in% c("up", "down")) %>%
  pull(gene_id) %>%
  unique() %>%
  na.omit() %>%
  as.character()

cat("PDT 响应显著差异基因数:", length(sig_entrez), "\n")

# ── 3. GO 富集分析 ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
go_res <- enrichGO(
  gene          = sig_entrez,
  OrgDb         = org.Hs.eg.db,
  ont           = "ALL",
  pAdjustMethod = "BH",
  pvalueCutoff  = 0.05,
  readable      = TRUE
)

# ── 4. KEGG 富集分析 ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
kegg_res <- enrichKEGG(
  gene          = sig_entrez,
  organism      = "hsa",
  pAdjustMethod = "BH",
  pvalueCutoff  = 0.05
)

# ── 5. 关键词筛选目标通路 ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
keywords <- c(
  "oxidative stress",
  "reactive oxygen species",
  "MAPK",
  "apoptot",
  "angiogenesis", "blood vessel",
  "migrat",
  "extracellular matrix",
  "TGF|transforming growth factor",
  "wound healing"
)
pattern <- paste(keywords, collapse = "|")

filter_terms <- function(df, src_label) {
  df %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    filter(str_detect(tolower(Description), tolower(pattern))) %>%
    mutate(Source = src_label)
}

go_sel   <- filter_terms(go_res,   "GO")
kegg_sel <- filter_terms(kegg_res, "KEGG")

cat("筛选到 GO 条目:", nrow(go_sel), "| KEGG 条目:", nrow(kegg_sel), "\n")

# ── 6. 合并并整理绘图数据 ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
combined <- bind_rows(
  go_sel   %>% arrange(p.adjust) %>% head(15),
  kegg_sel %>% arrange(p.adjust) %>% head(8)
) %>%
  mutate(
    logP         = -log10(p.adjust),
    GeneRatioNum = sapply(GeneRatio, function(x) {
      v <- as.numeric(unlist(strsplit(x, "/")))
      v[1] / v[2]
    }),
    Description  = str_wrap(Description, width = 40),
    # 保证 y 轴按 Source 分组后再按显著性排序
    Description  = factor(Description,
                          levels = rev(unique(Description)))
  )

# ── 7. 绘制气泡图 ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
p_2I <- ggplot(combined,
               aes(x     = GeneRatioNum,
                   y     = Description,
                   size  = Count,
                   color = logP)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.88) +
  scale_color_gradient(
    low  = "#9eaad1",
    high = "#f59790",
    name = "-log10(p.adjust)"
  ) +
  scale_size_continuous(
    range = c(3, 10),
    name  = "Gene Count"
  ) +
  facet_grid(Source ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    title = "GO/KEGG Enrichment of PDT Response Genes",
    x     = "Gene Ratio",
    y     = NULL
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title         = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 14),
    axis.text.y        = element_text(size = 9,  color = "black"),
    axis.text.x        = element_text(size = 10, color = "black"),
    strip.text         = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
    strip.background   = element_rect(fill = "gray92", color = "gray70"),
    legend.position    = "right",
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(linetype = "dashed", color = "gray88")
  )

print(p_2I)

# ── 8. 保存 ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ggsave("output/Fig2I_PDT_GO_KEGG_bubble.pdf",
       plot = p_2I, width = 9, height = 8)
ggsave("output/Fig2I_PDT_GO_KEGG_bubble.png",
       plot = p_2I, width = 9, height = 8, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
# =============================================================================
# Figure 2J: GSEA 富集曲线图（Post-PDT vs Pre-PDT）
# 展示 4 条通路：oxidative stress / MAPK / glucocorticoid / TGF-beta & ECM
# =============================================================================

rm(list = ls())
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(enrichplot)   # gseaplot2() 所在包
library(patchwork)

# ── 1. 载入数据 ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
load("stepout/step4output.Rdata")   # deg, Group

# ── 2. 构建 GSEA 输入：按 logFC 降序排列的命名向量 ────────────────────────────
# 去除重复 symbol，保留 |logFC| 最大的探针
gene_rank <- deg %>%
  filter(!is.na(symbol) & !is.na(gene_id)) %>%
  group_by(gene_id) %>%
  slice_max(abs(logFC), n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(desc(logFC))

ranked_vec <- setNames(gene_rank$logFC, gene_rank$gene_id)
cat("排序基因数:", length(ranked_vec), "\n")

# ── 3. 从 MSigDB 本地定义 4 条目标基因集（Hallmark / C2 经典集）──────────────
# 使用 clusterProfiler::GSEA 可直接用 msigdbr 包获取，此处用手动定义保证可复现
# 若已安装 msigdbr，可替换为：
#   library(msigdbr)
#   h_sets <- msigdbr(species="Homo sapiens", category="H") 等

# ── 推荐方式：msigdbr 自动获取（优先使用） ────────────────────────────────────
if (requireNamespace("msigdbr", quietly = TRUE)) {
  library(msigdbr)

  # Hallmark 基因集
  h_df <- msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", category = "H")
  # C2 KEGG / Reactome
  c2_df <- msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", category = "C2")

  make_gs <- function(df, pattern) {
    df %>%
      filter(str_detect(gs_name, pattern)) %>%
      select(gs_name, entrez_gene) %>%
      mutate(entrez_gene = as.character(entrez_gene))
  }

  gs_target <- bind_rows(
    make_gs(h_df,  "HALLMARK_OXIDATIVE_PHOSPHORYLATION|HALLMARK_REACTIVE_OXYGEN"),
    make_gs(h_df,  "HALLMARK_TNFA_SIGNALING|HALLMARK_IL6_JAK_STAT3"),  # 若无 MAPK Hallmark 用此替代
    make_gs(h_df,  "HALLMARK_GLUCOCORTICOID"),
    make_gs(h_df,  "HALLMARK_TGF_BETA_SIGNALING|HALLMARK_EPITHELIAL_MESENCHYMAL"),
    make_gs(c2_df, "KEGG_MAPK_SIGNALING_PATHWAY"),
    make_gs(c2_df, "KEGG_ECM_RECEPTOR_INTERACTION"),
    make_gs(c2_df, "REACTOME_CELLULAR_RESPONSE_TO_STRESS|REACTOME_RESPONSE_TO_REACTIVE_OXYGEN")
  )

  gs_list <- split(gs_target$entrez_gene, gs_target$gs_name)

} else {
  # ── 备用方式：手动定义精简版基因集（基于文献常用基因） ────────────────────
  message("未检测到 msigdbr 包，使用手动定义基因集。建议安装：install.packages('msigdbr')")

  # 将基因符号转为 Entrez ID
  sym2entrez <- function(symbols) {
    res <- bitr(symbols, fromType = "SYMBOL", toType = "ENTREZID", OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db)
    res$ENTREZID
  }

  gs_list <- list(
    "Oxidative_Stress_Response" = sym2entrez(c(
      "HMOX1","NQO1","TXNRD1","GPX1","SOD1","SOD2","CAT","PRDX1",
      "GCLC","GCLM","NFE2L2","KEAP1","DUSP1","SQSTM1","SESN2",
      "SRXN1","GLRX","TXN","GSR","G6PD"
    )),
    "MAPK_Signaling" = sym2entrez(c(
      "MAPK1","MAPK3","MAPK8","MAPK14","MAP2K1","MAP2K4",
      "HRAS","KRAS","BRAF","RAF1","MAP3K1","DUSP1","DUSP6",
      "ELK1","JUN","FOS","ATF2","MKK3","MKK6","MKK7"
    )),
    "Glucocorticoid_Response" = sym2entrez(c(
      "DUSP1","FKBP5","TSC22D3","GILZ","KLF9","SGK1","ZBTB16",
      "NFKBIA","TNFAIP3","PER1","CDKN1C","ERRFI1","ANGPTL4",
      "PDK4","LGALS1","DDIT4","CEBPD","BCL6","IRS2","PCK1"
    )),
    "TGFbeta_ECM" = sym2entrez(c(
      "TGFB1","TGFB2","TGFBR1","TGFBR2","SMAD2","SMAD3","SMAD4",
      "COL1A1","COL1A2","COL3A1","FN1","VIM","ACTA2","SERPINE1",
      "MMP2","MMP9","TIMP1","LOXL2","ITGA5","ITGB1","CDH2","SNAI1"
    ))
  )
  # 统一转为字符型
  gs_list <- lapply(gs_list, as.character)
}

# ── 4. 运行 GSEA ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
set.seed(42)
gsea_res <- GSEA(
  geneList     = ranked_vec,
  TERM2GENE    = bind_rows(lapply(names(gs_list), function(n)
    data.frame(term = n, gene = gs_list[[n]]))),
  pvalueCutoff = 1,        # 设为 1 保证 4 条通路都能出图（不因 p 值过滤掉）
  minGSSize    = 5,
  maxGSSize    = 500,
  eps          = 0,
  pAdjustMethod = "BH",
  verbose      = FALSE
)

print(gsea_res@result[, c("ID", "NES", "pvalue", "p.adjust")])

# ── 5. 配色方案（与全文一致） ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
# =============================================================================
# Figure 2J 出图部分（替换原来的第 5 步之后的所有代码）
# GSEA 结果 gsea_res 和 term_ids、gsea_colors 已在上方生成
# =============================================================================



term_ids    <- gsea_res@result$ID
gsea_colors <- c("#f59790", "#9eaad1", "#dacfe5", "#cde2e8")

cat("将绘制以下通路:\n")
print(term_ids)

# ── 方案：用 gridExtra::grid.arrange 直接拼接 gglist 对象 ────────────────────
# gseaplot2 返回 gglist，grid.arrange 可以接受

plot_list <- lapply(seq_along(term_ids), function(i) {
  gseaplot2(
    gsea_res,
    geneSetID    = term_ids[i],
    title        = str_replace_all(term_ids[i], "_", " "),
    color        = gsea_colors[(i - 1) %% length(gsea_colors) + 1],
    base_size    = 11,
    rel_heights  = c(1.5, 0.4, 0.8),
    pvalue_table = FALSE
  )
})

# 逐条单独保存，完全不需要拼图转换
pdf("output/Fig2J_GSEA_curves.pdf", width = 6, height = 5)
for (i in seq_along(term_ids)) {
  p <- gseaplot2(
    gsea_res,
    geneSetID    = term_ids[i],
    title        = str_replace_all(term_ids[i], "_", " "),
    color        = gsea_colors[(i - 1) %% length(gsea_colors) + 1],
    base_size    = 12,
    rel_heights  = c(1.5, 0.4, 0.8),
    pvalue_table = FALSE
  )
  print(p)   # 每条通路输出到 PDF 的一页
}
dev.off()

# 同时逐条保存 PNG
for (i in seq_along(term_ids)) {
  p <- gseaplot2(
    gsea_res,
    geneSetID    = term_ids[i],
    title        = str_replace_all(term_ids[i], "_", " "),
    color        = gsea_colors[(i - 1) %% length(gsea_colors) + 1],
    base_size    = 12,
    rel_heights  = c(1.5, 0.4, 0.8),
    pvalue_table = FALSE
  )
  ggsave(
    paste0("output/Fig2J_", term_ids[i], ".png"),
    plot = p, width = 6, height = 5, dpi = 300
  )
}
cat("全部 GSEA 图已保存\n")

cat("Fig2J 保存完成！\n")
```
